text.tspan: Normalised as score / Joint ceiling, the same scale the retention matrices use.
Backward transfer is final − just-learned. The random floor is not 0 on this scale; on Pong it is −100%.
Every number is computed over the tasks that run has finished, counted under each column. Nothing is
extrapolated, so the columns are not comparable. A mean over fewer tasks is not a mean over five.

tspan.tspan: CLEAR, CKA-RL, CompoNet complete; Min-Max (ours) at 4 of 5.

text.tspan: * Forward transfer unresolved. Not measurable from these runs (per-task heads, untrained until
that task arrives), and the from-scratch baseline the AUC form needs is being recomputed.
Treat every forward-transfer number in this project as provisional.
